verdict.rationale: Mastra's own observability documents tracking cost, model calls and tool usage across production agent runs, plus a searchable timeline of every tool call. That covers the call-volume and cost parts of the story. It is framed per agent run rather than as org-level analytics for the servers and tools consumed or published. Missing for 10: per-user usage breakdowns, error-rate analytics, aggregation by MCP server, org-wide consumption/publish views, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see usage analytics for the servers and tools my org consumes or publishes — call volumes, users, errors, and cost

citations.quote: Track latency, cost, model calls, and tool usage across every production agent run.
Inspect every model call, tool call, and handoff from one searchable timeline.
